name: To Spec
description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.
longDescription: No interview: synthesizes the conversation and codebase into a spec. First proposes the **seams** to test at (existing over new, as high as possible, ideally one) and checks them with you, then publishes to the tracker configured by `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` with the `ready-for-agent` label. The template has **7 sections**, from Problem Statement and an exhaustive numbered user-story list through Implementation and Testing Decisions to Out of Scope. Omits file paths and code snippets except prototype-derived shapes that encode a decision. Uses the project's domain glossary and respects ADRs.
